notes: 'Open world explorer game' is a self-declared Adventure on world-open — one contiguous map crossed in any order — and the answers keep it to a few minutes by car, so it is one surface rather than separate regions. Exploration is the preset; path-trail carries the hikes, walks and mud tracks and is bent wide enough for the off-road vehicles, and terrain-relief carries the mountain the prompt asks to climb, which is the tiered flag with nothing overhanging. I did not name Simulation as a second genre even though ten or more vehicles is a lot of vehicles: the answers make them ride options for getting around a map you explore, not a machinery or job loop, and Vehicle Sim's shared resource field would build an extraction economy nobody asked for. No loaded option covers a bare 'spawn place', so I assumed it sits at a trailhead where the vehicles are parked, and left it out of the option list rather than forcing a checkpoint row.
